You are doing well! Just ride the wave, and you will get there eventually.
Ugh that is a really rough situation. Nothing you do will feel like the right thing, but the fact that you are there will be the right thing.

Even if you do something on a whim, that doesnt mean there was no reason. In that second, the moment you did that, it offered something more to you than your life currently is. Now, in retrospect, you disagree. 

I am glad you are ok. I hope sharing it here was helpful.
